title: An integral scalar curvature bound for real simplicial volume
main_claim: For n>=3 there is a_n>0 with ∫_M (Scal_g^-)^{n/2} dV_g >= a_n ||M|| for every closed oriented n-manifold M and every metric g (Gromov's 1986 conjecture). Route: (1) a Yamabe reduction to Scal=-1, using the companion's vanishing theorem; (2) a bounded-cocycle detector form on the probability simplex; (3) weighted graph sweeps and phases giving the entropy metrics S(h,φ) >= -C + 2W - n log E + E e_h(F), with a small gradient and a label graph of controlled degree; (4) a measured μ-bubble degree theorem with absolute constants; (5) a rounded dual-cube chain with Gaifullin resolution and comparison lengths L_T=b√E, L_N=b√(qE), which cancel all powers of E and q.

issues.description: The whole argument depends on the companion manuscript's Corollary 1.5: a closed manifold with a metric of nonnegative scalar curvature has zero simplicial volume. That is a major open-type statement in its own right, and it is cited here, not proved. The Yamabe reduction itself is correct: the sign of Y matches the sign of the constant scalar curvature, and the Hölder step checks.
issues.evidence: Prop 2.2 proof: 'Its scalar curvature is negative by Theorem vanishing-input'. Board for family 335 had no sibling report on the companion.

issues.location: Sec. 6, Lemma 6.4 (measured resolution) and Sec. 5.4 (singular μ-bubbles, p>=7)
issues.description: Two parts were checked only in outline, not line by line. One is the quantitative Gaifullin-type resolution: the envelopes K_R(q), K_scal(q) and H_0(q), and the claim that the seam has coordinate volume <= mλ. The other is the geometric-measure-theory compactness and Borel-selection arguments for singular boundaries. No specific failure was found in either.
issues.evidence: Coverage limitation, not a demonstrated error.
